items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: And then he said to me, “And if it doesn’t work out, Peter, you’ve still got a job here.”

ctx.x: He was a driver, or an assistant. Anyway, I got into this nice clothing store and about the time, after about three or four weeks, I got my union card, and I got a gig in a bar. And I had to do a Saturday matinee you see? Oh, how the hell am I going to get away to do this matinee on a Saturday with a clothing store. So I told my manager. He said, “Peter,” he said, “take your lunch from 3 to 4 and if Harry asks where you are I’ll say you’ve gone off on an errand from 4 to 5” you see. The place wasn’t very far…
